name: Mastra Factory OG social card by Mastra Factory
description: A stark monochrome 1200×630 social card. The mastra wordmark with its dotted molecule-like mark sits top-left, while the page title "Factory" is set large and bold on the lower-left baseline, leaving the right two-thirds and the middle band entirely as empty black negative space. The tension between the two corner-anchored text blocks and the vast emptiness gives the card its confidence; no illustration, gradient or imagery competes with the type.
